concerns.text: The plan assumes the existence of a peer‑reviewed experimental permeability dataset (FR‑016) but the research document flags that no such dataset is currently available, causing the pipeline to abort. Without a valid target variable the core research question (predicting permeability) cannot be answered.

The power analysis assumes a medium effect size (Cohen’s d = 0.5) and computes power using only the 5 CV folds. With n = 5 paired observations the test is severely under‑powered; the analysis will likely over‑estimate power and cannot reliably support the claim of sufficient statistical power.

concerns.location: plan.md:Data size limitation and sampling (FR‑001, FR‑004)
concerns.text: Limiting the dataset to a maximum of 500 pairs and randomly sampling when more are available introduces potential selection bias. The plan does not describe how the sampled subset will remain representative of the full distribution (e.g., stratification beyond gas type), which threatens external validity of the model evaluation.

Stratified 5‑fold CV by gas type controls for gas‑type distribution but does not address other confounds such as framework size, surface area, or pore volume that may correlate with permeability. No explicit modeling or covariate adjustment is described, leaving possible confounding effects unaccounted for.
